fusions.name: Dazzle Glint
fusions.desc: Throws a flash of silver that deals 10 damage and stuns the target for 1 second. Its damage rises 6% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Sleight Shot
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that costs 4% of your maximum health and deals 8 damage, up to 2.2 times as much at maximum range. Each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Glint and Vanish
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds, and you move 25% faster. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Last Laugh
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you gain a ward worth 10% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
